surfaceMatrix.summary: Each successful live-refresh attempt is authenticated before evaluation, artifact, or output effects.
Baseline equality and required-capability mismatches reject before provider requests or spend.
Receipt, head, and anchor inputs are byte-bounded before decoding or JSON parsing.
Route lineage, privacy, exact economics, bounded spend, and deterministic outcomes remain covered.

residualRisks: Live OpenRouter behavior remains outside offline CI and needs an explicit field-operation grant.
V1-07 must compose recommendation authorization with current receipt and policy verification.
